items.thumbnailPrompt: Create ONE isolated common-rarity game fish inventory thumbnail. Use reference ONLY for style: warm friendly rounded cartoon fish, crisp dark-brown contour, large glossy eye, soft cel shading, no mammal features, no props. Face SCREEN RIGHT in clear SIDE profile. Head mouth snout RIGHT, body tail LEFT; forward swimming right, never front/left/backward. Entire animal visible with safe 10% margin on TRUE transparent background. No water, floor shadow, text, borders or checkerboard. Medium fish, strong readable species-specific silhouette. A plump elongated sea bass with slate blue-grey back, silver cream belly, broad mouth and one spiny dorsal silhouette, darker subtle grey flecks and forked smoky tail, strong swimming fins. Modest natural silver fish, no fantasy armor.
items.spritePrompt: Create a 2x2 sprite sheet of EXACTLY FOUR sequential swimming poses of the SAME fish in reference. Reference is identity and rendering style, preserve colors anatomy face and proportions exactly. Entire square image has four equal square cells, no gutters or drawn dividing lines. Each cell shows ONE COMPLETE fish facing SCREEN RIGHT, head mouth snout RIGHT, tail trailing LEFT, same side view in all four. True transparent background. Keep EVERY fin and tail within central 76% width and 70% height of each cell: at least 12% fully empty safety margin on ALL four edges. Never clip artwork at cell boundaries. Identical head/eye and cheek position and identical body scale in all cells: eye center at (78% cell width,49% cell height), body center near (48%,52%). Body head remain rigid and level, no vertical bobbing or shifting rows. Animate a small natural FOUR PHASE tail swish and gentle rear dorsal fin wave: tail tips curve up, neutral, down, neutral with subtle fin spread; pectoral fins only slight stabilizing strokes, never big arm waving. This must be FOUR DISTINCT locomotion poses, not four copies or eye-only blinking. Open eye consistent. Row-major 0-1-2-3 seamless looping. No text, labels, watermark, water, background color, checkerboard or shadows. Same moderate brown outline and soft cartoon shading as approved fish reference. CRITICAL SAFETY REVISION: Make each fish MUCH SMALLER than previous: total fish width EXACTLY 60 percent of its cell, centered x=50%, full body between x=20% and x=80%, top/bottom at least20%. There must be a large wide empty transparent band surrounding EVERY fish. Eye x=72%, y=50%. Tail, fins and ALL alpha pixels must remain WELL INSIDE cell. No loose pixels or sparkles. The transparent margin is mandatory; do not fill the cells.
